records.editorial_status: REMOVE - misattribution protocol. It closed a physiological argument with a gesture of cosmic laughter, releasing the argument rather than advancing it; the section's own prior line is the better close.
records.notes: LONGCHENPA CONVERSION DECLINED. His thought - everything is illusion, therefore perfect, therefore laughable - is a Dzogchen claim about the emptiness of appearances. A recovered ancestor is only a repair when the ancestor's actual thought belongs at that location.

I know' - and the manuscript substituted EXPERIENCE inside a paragraph arguing for experience over belief. The authentic statement does not make the argument; the altered one does. The book already had the stronger sentence. Seam clean, no replacement prose.

records.text: As within, so without. As above, so below.

records.editorial_status: REFRAME - LINEAGE + AUTHORIAL DERIVATION. The composite formula no longer stands as a quotation with a source. The chapter now names the tradition and then names its own extension of it: 'The Emerald Tablet gives the correspondence as above and below. Spiralogic extends it inward: as within, so without.' This tells the reader where tradition ends and the model begins, which saving the popular formula would not.

Its ancestor EA-Q-0108 (the accurate Emerald Tablet form, Ch9, public domain) is KEPT unchanged and is what makes this reframe possible.
